summary_en: JIG-SAW authorized acquisition of up to 90,000 shares (1.4% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥270 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 14, 2026 to January 27, 2027, as part of balanced capital policy combining growth investment, financial discipline, and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 16, 2026, JIG-SAW's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 90,000 ordinary shares for a maximum of ¥270 million through on-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between December 14, 2026 and January 27, 2027. This represents 1.4% of outstanding shares (6,583,063 shares excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026). The calculated per-share ceiling is approximately ¥3,000 based on the maximum acquisition amount.

The buyback is undertaken as part of the company's ongoing capital policy, balancing growth investment in core business areas with financial discipline. The company views continuous and flexible capital management, combined with expanded shareholder returns, as essential to sustained enhancement of enterprise value. JIG-SAW has conducted regular treasury stock acquisitions since listing and intends to continue evaluating shareholder return measures. The company noted that it may not acquire the full authorized amount if market conditions warrant.
